sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are on top form with five consecutive wins and just one draw in their last six outings, while Alsager Town arrive in dire straits at the foot of the table with just four points from ten games and no wins in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away in a match with title-race implications, as Stafford sit just two points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a fixture between mid-table sides both capable of challenging for honours. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a local derby, with both sides showing inconsistent form recently. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while New Mills visit Market Drayton Town—a clash between two struggling sides. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both teams near the bottom seeking points. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle, and Shawbury United host Barnton as the hosts look to escape their current poor run of form.
